notes.title: GOG is giving away this lovely little island adventure game for free
notes.notes: No need to thank me, but I just sorted out your weekend plans. Haven Park, a charming, cozy, and lovely little island adventure game from 2021 is now free on GOG. Claim it before time runs out on January 23 at 6 am PST / 2 pm UTC, and you can keep it forever... Read more.

notes.title: Haven Park mixes A Short Hike with Animal Crossing and is currently free to keep
notes.notes:
Are there any sweeter words than "A Short Hike-like"? Both because the sweet, mountain adventure is one of my favourite games, and because "Hike-like" is a fun rhyme. Well, anyway, Haven Park is like A Short Hike crossed with Animal Crossing, and it's currently free to keep from GOG.

Read more

notes.title: Patch 1.2.4 with a fixed draw bridge!
notes.notes: Some of you reported the drawbridge not working properly anymore, so we had a look and found the bug! The gate behind the drawbridge should now open again when you finished the crown quest!

notes.title: It's Christmas time again!
notes.notes:
Hey all!

We just published a small patch that enables the Christmas mode again! From now on, Christmas mode is automatically activated each year in December (or you can change your system time to December for a whole year of Christmas :D).

Other than that not much has changed except some very minor fixes for issues that popped up over the last couple of months. If you find any other issues, please keep sending in your reports so we can try and address everything!

Happy Holidays everyone!
Your Mooneye team

notes.title: Fixed Completionist Steam achievement
notes.notes: The Completionist achievement (finishing all quests) was buggy after we removed the Christmas content. That should be fixed now :) If you already completed all quests without the achievement triggering, just start the game and it should work!

notes.title: The Holiday Season has ended
notes.notes: Sadly, the Holiday season has come to an end in Haven Park as well! But fear not, you can still finish your already started Christmas quest. And if you have not started it yet: Santa will be back next Christmas! :)

notes.title: Santa Claus is Coming to Town - Literally!
notes.notes:
Hey festive people of Steam!

We have a lovely update for you! We really wanted you to visit your campers over the holiday, so here's some hopefully convincing arguments to go visit Haven Park again:

[list]
[*] Santa Claus is in town and he scattered his presents all over. I think he needs your help!
[*] You have the opportunity to fix a certain relationship before the year is over and make someone really happy
[*] Christmas lights! Look at the village, it's so cozy <3
[*] A new building
[*] Some minor fixes
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this addition to Haven Park!
Have a lovely holiday and a happy New Year! 

Festive hugs and kisses,

Your moonies and Fabien

notes.title: A few small features and fixes: Patch 1.1.1 is here!
notes.notes:
After finally opening the mine last week, we implemented some of your suggested features and fixed some bugs. Here's what changed:

[list]
[*] added a "leave mine" button to the map when in the mine, so you can leave early if you'd rather explore the main island a bit more
[*] fixed some dialogues in the mine to hopefully fix any bugs causing you to be stuck in the dialogue
[*] you can now play the guitar in the mine
[*] fixed some collisions
[*] fixed some typos
[/list]

And that's about it :) If you find any more bugs or have other suggestions, please continue to reach out here or in the game's discord over at https://discord.gg/nN3YmEa9!

Your moonies & Fabien <3

notes.title: New Area! - The Mine is finally explorable!
notes.notes:
Patch 1.1 is live right now! 

You've been asking for it since day one and now the day is here: 

[b]The mine is finally opened up for exploration! 
Jump in a mine cart and find out what's hidden deep in the mountain![/b]


Here's a list of changes in this version:
[list]
[*]  Brand-New Area to explore: The Mine
[*]  New building: The Hammock
[*]  New unlockable decoration
[*]  Water shader improvement
[*]  Cable Car reworked
[*]  A bunch of minor bug fixes
[/list]

We hope your campers love their new hammocks and you enjoy exploring the mine! <3 

Slightly spooky cheers,

Your moonies and Fabien

notes.title: Quick fix for food trucks - Patch 1.0.8.1
notes.notes: We just uploaded a new small patch after we heard that the food trucks weren't working after our last patch. Nothing else has changed, but campers won't have to go to sleep hungry anymore! :)

notes.title: Of Bugs and Snowmen: Patch 1.0.8
notes.notes:
We're back with another patch in our pockets and here's what it brings:

[list]
[*] you can now toggle the effects of certain skills on and off
[*] the save slots now show your total playtime
[*] items in your inventory are now sorted with ressources showing at the top
[*] we fixed a bug that could lead to a specific quest being broken
[*] some other minor fixes
[/list]

If you experience any bugs or have suggestions to improve your gameplay, don't hesitate to contact us! :)

Your moonies & Fabien

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7 brings highly requested feature
notes.notes:
We just published the next patch - version 1.0.7 - and have added a feature that has been highly requested and should help you finishing the park maintenance! This is what changed:

[list]
[*] the map now shows which areas you have completed, both regarding camp status and repairables in the park, making it much easier to know where to look to find the last broken lantern or torch!
[*] we reordered the categories in the building menu in camps so the campfire is now the very first object selected. We saw a lot of you had problems figuring out how to attract new campers and how to read the building list at the bottom of the screen. With the campfire now being the first object in that list, we hope it's easier to understand that the first camper will arrive after building that (or anything else from the "resting" category)
[*] the game now always saves when you receive a new quest (instead of just every 30 seconds)
[*] we fixed some localization issues, especially with newly added texts from the last patch
[*] some other minor fixes
[/list]

We hope you like the changes and good luck with fixing the whole park, now that you know where to look! :) 

We'll keep collecting all your feedback and implement new features (or improve existing ones), so if you have suggestions, we're all ear! :) 

Cheers,

your moonies & Fabien

notes.title: First Patch coming in hot!
notes.notes:
Hi again,

the new patch we published to the beta branch earlier today seems to be working just fine, so now all of you get to enjoy the new features and fixes! 😊 

Here's what has changed:

[list]
[*] added "tailor" skill that will spawn more fabric in the world
[*] added option to remove resources from the inventory
[*] added option to toggle depth of field
[*] fixed missing option to refill wood at campfires
[*] fixed missing collision on mountain in the North
[*] fixed Russian font
[*] some more fixes that would spoil things if we explained it ;)
[/list]

Let us know what you think and
Have a lovely time in Haven Park!

Cheers,

your moonies

notes.title: First Patch on new Beta branch
notes.notes:
Hey you guys,

Thank you so much for playing Haven Park! The feedback so far was wonderful! But of course there's also some bugs and improvements as for any game!

We have the first patch for you and it contains among other smaller fixes: 

[list]
[*] added "tailor" skill that will spawn more fabric in the world
[*] added option to remove resources from the inventory (click on a resource in the notebook)
[*] added option to toggle depth of field
[*] fixed missing option to refill wood at campfires
[*] fixed missing collision on mountain in the North
[*] fixed Russian font
[/list]

At the moment the patch is applied to the new Beta branch. We created a Beta branch to push even quicker fixes. It will often have a newer version than the default branch. But be aware that it's also not tested as thoroughly, so no quarantees on anything over there! :) 
We'll be grateful for any bug reports! 

Here's how to access the Beta branch:

In your Steam library, right-click on Haven Park > Click on "Properties" > Choose tab "Betas" > From the dropdown menu choose "beta - Public Beta Branch" > This will trigger an update to be downloaded and there you go into crazy Beta land ;)

As soon as we feel safe with this version, we'll also upload it to the main branch for those of you who prefer not to jump between branches. Not all of us are birdies after all <3

Cheers,

Your moonies

notes.title: Haven Park is a short and cozy island management game that I never want to end
notes.notes: Remember how Untitled Goose Game had a dedicated 'honk' button we never got tired of tapping? Haven Park, released today on Steam, GoG, and itch.io, is another game starring a bird, but instead of an asshole goose you're the sweetest little bird ever equipped with a dedicated 'pew' button... Read more.

notes.title: A Short Hike-alike Haven Park is out today and brings with it loads of wholesome adventure
notes.notes:
The sweet, camping exploration game Haven Park is out today, and takes inspiration from the equally charming indie title A Short Hike by Adam Robinson-Yu, and also from Nintendo's popular villager hoarder Animal Crossing. Haven Park hopes to make us love the outdoors again despite the state of things - at least by the looks of its screenshots and gameplay videos. Like any successful game, you play as a bird named Flint, exploring the park around you. The soundtrack fits the gameplay shown in its trailer quite nicely, and reminded me of the work Natureboy Flako did producing the futuristic, chill sounds of indie explorer Stonefly.

Read more

notes.title: Relax and rebuild a campsite in the chilled-out Haven Park out now
notes.notes:
Haven Park is a short and casual experience for people who love to do a little exploring, while also doing a little building and repair work too.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/08/relax-and-rebuild-a-campsite-in-the-chilled-out-haven-park-out-now

notes.title: 7 New Languages Implemented! (but not tested, so we need your feedback, please)
notes.notes:
Hi again,

We quickly implemented 7 (!) new languages so you would be able to play the demo in your preferred language. We did not have the time to test them though, so your feedback would be very much appreciated <3 There will be lines that don't fit their box yet and all that, so your notebook might look a little messy ;) We'd be especially interested to hear what you think about the translation itself. Do you think it works well? Does it convey the same tone as the English version?
And don't worry, we'll still do the testing before full release.

Can't wait to hear what you think <3

The Haven Park Demo is now available in:
[list]
[*]English
[*]French
[*]German
[*]Spanish (Spain)
[*]Italian
[*]Brazilian Portuguese
[*]Russian
[*]Japanese
[*]Simplified Chinese
[*]Traditional Chinese
[/list]

Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Time to play Haven Park! First Demo Live
notes.notes:
Hey folks!

We cannot wait to see what the [b]Next Fest[/b] has in store for us all!

We DO know what we are contributing though: [b]Haven Park's very first playable demo![/b]

Decorate the first four camps and attract more whimsical characters to tell you their stories and wishes. Make sure everyone has the best of holidays. Grandma will be so proud! <3

We hope you enjoy the demo! If you do please [b]wishlist[/b] so you're the first to know when there's any news. Remember, Haven Park will be launching with a limited time release offer on August 5 and you don't want to miss that, right? ;)

Also, don't forget to join one of our [b]live streams[/b]. The first one is today, right here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1549550/view/4982651095249819855

Looking forward to seeing you there!
Cheers,

Your Moonies and Fabien

notes.title: Haven Park: Live-Gameplay and Developer Q&A
notes.notes:
Haven Park was developed by Fabien Weibel who recently partnered with Mooneye Indies to publish his very first game. Fabien and Tobias (Mooneye) talk about what inspired Haven Park, lessons learned on the way to a game release and what they love about Haven Park.

You can ask any questions you might have regarding the game or its development or just watch us play and talk about Haven Park!

notes.title: Introducing Mooneye Indies and Haven Park
notes.notes:
[b]Hi Community! We have big news today! [/b]

We created our own indie publishing label called Mooneye Indies in order to help narrative and wholesome indie games reach the audience they deserve. Way too often the most wonderful little gems fly under the radar even though the community is out there looking for beautiful wholesome games or meaningful narrative experiences. Especially small indie teams struggle with reaching enough people, to make all their blood, sweat and tears worth it when the title finally sees the light of day. We learned so much while self-publishing Lost Ember worldwide and on multiple platforms simultaneously, that we decided to share what we learned and help others.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34003126/b0be06264a2e1894bbd9ff3353315fc9d58482c7.jpg[/img]

Cut to the chase though :D We are completely in love with our first title as a publisher and could not have found a more wholesome game to start out with. 
I present to you: 

[b]Haven Park[/b]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34003126/d933e87b4b78d13ff8c920e1b65791b544d64396.png[/img]

Help Flint make grandma's park the best it can be in order to attract even more quirky characters.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34003126/e8aec23ab872f7a9ae86c733df7170f936ecf6f5.png[/img]

Visit Flint here and wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1549550/Haven_Park/

Thank you for listening!
Cheers,

Your moonies
